_doc: A frozen market, and the trades the strategy produces on it. `baseline` is the program as it stood before the minimum swing size ‹A7› and touch-close ‹A10› were added; `shipped` is with both. The test replays the current program over `candles` and must reproduce `shipped` exactly — same touch candle, entry candle, stage, direction, entry, exit and outcome. Any rule change anywhere in the strategy moves this file.
_source: 89 pairs × 99 one-minute candles from the Pocket Option feed, 2026-08-19
_candles: per symbol: [firstTimeSeconds, then open, high, low, close, minutesAfterFirst × N]
_covers: all 89 pairs, including the ones that produce no trade — so a trade APPEARING where there was none fails this test too, not only a trade vanishing
